title: Stadtler annual review: RMD, QCD, Roth conversion and DAF
notes: The parish pledge is given twice as $12,000 (once to the associate) before Everett reads the parish email showing $15,000, which also moves the taxable RMD remainder from $35,388 to $32,388, and the first statement of the conversion amount is mis-transcribed as $17,000, so $70,000 has to be recovered from the $215,000 income figure, the $15,000 tax estimate and later turns. The parish-information task moves from Lorraine to Everett, the projection moves from the 23rd to the 30th, and a QLAC, a 529 for the granddaughter, a 40/60 allocation and a QCD into the DAF are all raised and not adopted. The closing recap omits Lorraine's call to the CPA and the conversion and distribution forms, and the risk discussion ends in an explicit no change.
